correctness.rationale: The rank-\(t\) Laplacian resolvent identity is positive definite for \(s\ge3\) and yields the explicitly derived transfer formula. Disjoint currents reduce exactly to three reciprocal-match cases; the signed orbit enumeration and the graph maximum principle give all absolute columns. Four factorized orbit differences have positive denominators and strictly positive numerators on each applicable integer domain. The saturated value uses Foster trace and exact reverse current. The terminal differences are positive. A standalone grounded-inverse replay corroborated 39 graphs and 1,370 columns but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The entire natural interpolation from balanced biclique to crown has a nontrivial maximum-absolute-column orbit law. A new positive disjoint transfer-current class starts at two deletions, all intermediate maximizers concentrate on the untouched sub-biclique, and a single final deletion restores edge transitivity with an order-\(s^{-2}\) effect after order-\(s^{-3}\) aggregate preceding changes. These structural and sharp asymptotic statements are not mere restatements of a pseudoinverse.
